snippet.title: Fleshgrinder - Demo Gameplay Trailer #1
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5078480/Fleshgrinder_Demo/

Prepared for the #Steam #nextfest 

Social links below.

More about the game:

Fleshgrinder tries to present a possible dystopian world where a digital virus that can infect humans goes on its own agenda,
since the infection vector is really high after most of us will have cybernetic augmentations to upskill our species with
augmentations like Neuralink.

In the game's story, SynTech is responsible for research and development of these implants and since they are running proprietary
 software on these augs inside our bodies connected to our nervous system, their latest research in Terminus Points Genesis Chamber
  to digitally try to enhance the species through DNA mutations goes terribly wrong. They created a digital virus that appears to behave
   in a hive-minded manner that takes over the minds of anyone who can be infected through their wireless protocols,
    direct contact with infected tissue, or other supply-chain based attacks. 

It harvests DNA by collecting biomass, while rare-earth metals and other synthetic materials are also a vector
 so that it can create mutants and evolve them.

Ingame, this is reflected by the Fleshgrinder infrastructure with machines like the Fleshprocessor and Fleshprinter,
 which takes humanoids as inputs and outputs different types of monsters while collecting materials that can advance
  the Genesis Tiers - strengthening all monsters throughout the world and spawning attacks on the player.

Features optional friendly fire, hardcore permadeath mode, 
dismemberment physics, randomized mission areas, 30+ weapons, 60+ armors, augmentations,
 consumables, ammo types with deep penetration mechanics and tons of loot with highly randomized attributes.
  NPCs with lots of side-quests and a faction reputation system which determines trade prices,
   dialogue choices and overall behaviour. 11 unique enemy types in a huge persistent world where everything stays as you left it.


One squad. Strategic choices. Permanent consequences.

FLESHGRINDER: Evolution Without Waiting. Extinction Without Mercy.
